name: replace-similar-simple
description: Simple ladder for Replace with similar (PARITY-REPLACE): the feature is pro-tier so it is hidden in Simple mode and present in Pro. In Pro, place a sofa in the room editor, select it, open the Replace-with-similar picker, screenshot the ranked list, pick the first (nearest-size) alternative, and assert the defId changed while position + rotation are preserved.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: assert-hidden-in-simple
steps.eval: if (window.__store.getState().featureFlags.replaceSimilar !== false) throw new Error('replaceSimilar should be OFF in Simple mode, got: ' + window.__store.getState().featureFlags.replaceSimilar)

steps.name: assert-present-in-pro
steps.failMessage: replaceSimilar should be ON in Pro mode

steps.name: place-sofa
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setItems([{ id: 'rs-sofa-1', defId: 'sofa-3seat', position: [9, 3], rotation: 1.5707963, props: {} }])

steps.name: inspector-visible
steps.failMessage: Inspector did not appear after selecting the sofa

steps.name: pick-first-alternative
steps.eval: (() => { const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#swapPanel .swap-card')); if (cards.length === 0) throw new Error('No alternatives rendered in the picker'); cards[0].click(); })()

steps.name: wait-replaced
steps.failMessage: defId did not change after picking an alternative

steps.name: assert-place-preserved
steps.eval: (() => { const a = window.__rsBefore; const b = window.__store.getState().items.find(i => i.id === 'rs-sofa-1'); if (b.position[0] !== a.position[0] || b.position[1] !== a.position[1]) throw new Error('position changed: ' + JSON.stringify(b.position)); if (b.rotation !== a.rotation) throw new Error('rotation changed: ' + b.rotation); if (b.defId === a.defId) throw new Error('defId unchanged'); })()
